transcript.text: Can you describe your role and key responsibilities as a Medical Officer at the 120-bed private hospital in Ahmedabad?

I'm an MBBS doctor and have worked for five years, the last three as a medical officer in a 120-bed private hospital in Ahmedabad. I cover outpatient and emergency shifts and make the monthly duty rota for eight junior doctors, though that is an informal duty. I was also part of a hospital committee that reduced the discharge delay from 4 hours to 2.5. That is when I realised how much patient experience depends on operations. I want an MBA to move into hospital management.
How did you manage preparing the monthly duty rota for 8 junior doctors without a formal reporting line?

feedback.summary: The candidate has clinical experience as a Medical Officer and involvement in hospital operations through informal duties and committee participation. However, there are inconsistencies in statements about formal roles and reluctance to share specific examples or outcomes, limiting insight into their personal ownership and impact in operations and management initiatives.
